view: Tula Hidalgo Pyramid B top four Toltec atlantean warrior stone columns in a row seen slightly from below at three-quarter angle, cylindrical monumental stone figures with rectangular headdresses and butterfly breastplates, lower stepped platform foreground. Four rigid carved figures not living warriors, no roof or invented Greek temple.

eras.title: The warrior columns
eras.caption: At Tula, carved warrior figures stand above a stepped temple platform. These monumental supports belonged to the architecture of the Toltec capital; their weapons, headdresses and rigid stance are carved details, rather than portraits of people at work.
